Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elsy usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the elms and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name has been used throughout history in various cultures, symbolizing faithfulness, loyalty, and spiritual maturity.
